images.prompt: Full-bleed square logo artwork on a flat deep violet field. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw any chrome arch, badge outline, oval, shield, ring, plaque, emblem border or enclosing shape around the artwork — a previous attempt wrongly enclosed everything in a chrome arched badge. The bell and the wordmark must float directly on the violet background with nothing drawn around them. Subject: a neon-magenta bell ringing so violently it has cracked down one side, jagged fracture lines radiating outward, chrome bevelled edge on the bell itself only, hard specular highlight, motion arcs on both sides. 90s extreme-sports airbrush energy, ultraviolet glow bloom. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: TACO BELLIGERENT, in a bold italic condensed sans-serif beneath the bell. Nothing else may be written.

Cinematic wide establishing shot of a late-night Tex-Mex fast-food restaurant drive-thru at 2am. IMPORTANT: this is a restaurant, not a gas station — no fuel pumps, no fuel dispensers, no pump islands anywhere in frame. An angular chrome-and-purple restaurant building with tall dark windows and a narrow cantilevered canopy over a single curving drive-thru lane, a closed order window with a chrome speaker post beside it, steam venting from a rooftop kitchen exhaust unit into cold air. Wet black asphalt mirrors magenta and violet neon in long streaks and puddles. One lonely sedan waits in the lane, red tail lights reflecting down the wet lane. Empty parking lot, sodium lamps at the far edge, low ground fog. Lighting: neon rim light, magenta key with ultraviolet fill, deep crushed blacks, anamorphic lens flare. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, deep focus, high contrast, fine filmic grain. Deadpan hyperreal cinematic realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
